landing.heroSubtitle: Build company-tailored cover letters with your experience library and job analysis.
landing.featuresSubtitle: From prep to writing and review — in one place
landing.feature1Desc: Structure projects and achievements for AI-powered retrieval.
landing.feature2Desc: Extract skills and keywords from postings for tailored writing.
landing.feature3Desc: RAG, generation, review, and interview prep in a 3-pane layout.
landing.authPitch: Faster, sharper cover letters tailored to each company.

common.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete?

onboarding.title: Getting started
onboarding.step1Desc: Store projects and achievements in your library.
onboarding.step2Desc: Upload and analyze target job postings.
onboarding.step3Desc: Generate your letter in the workspace.

experiences.title: Experience Library
experiences.pageHint: Store experiences for cover-letter generation. Merge similar ones; split different angles.
experiences.emptyHint: Add concrete project/integration/ops stories so recommendation and generation work better.
experiences.limitReached: You can save up to {{max}} experiences. Remove unused ones first.
experiences.reembedFailed: Failed to refresh the RAG index.
experiences.guideMain: Detail beats volume. Role, description, and outcomes (numbers if real) work best.
experiences.guideSelect: In Workspace, up to 5 experiences are selected per generation.
experiences.formHint: One experience = one clear angle. Fill situation, role, and result—not just a title.
experiences.typeHint: Project, tech, leadership, etc. help section-aware recommendations.
experiences.titleExample: e.g. CMS upgrade with SAP integration
experiences.descriptionExample: What, why, and how—without inventing numbers.
experiences.descriptionHint: Aim for 80+ characters so RAG has enough signal.
experiences.resultExample: e.g. Shipped on schedule; automated inventory checks
experiences.numericResultHint: Only real numbers. Leave blank if none.
experiences.contributionExample: What you personally owned or decided

jobPostings.title: Job Postings
jobPostings.importDescription: Paste a Saramin or JobKorea posting URL to import full details. Text and file upload are also supported.
jobPostings.contentPlaceholder: Paste job description or drag PDF/image/text file...
jobPostings.urlHint: From Saramin/JobKorea links, imports only sections that exist (responsibilities, requirements, preferred, conditions, benefits, etc.).

writingStyle.title: Writing Style
writingStyle.description: Analyze your existing cover letter to capture your writing style for AI generation.
writingStyle.placeholder: Paste cover letter text to analyze...
writingStyle.loadSectionDesc: Import text from an existing cover letter.
writingStyle.inputSectionDesc: Paste the cover letter body for style analysis.
writingStyle.resultDesc: Traits used as reference when AI generates content.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.guide: ① Pick or enter a job posting → ② Adjust the Rewrite Level → ③ Click generate to write your cover letter. You can request recommended experiences at any time.
workspace.step1Hint: Select a saved posting or type the job description directly — only one is required.
workspace.jobTextDisabledPlaceholder: This field is unused while a saved posting is selected
workspace.jobTextDisabledHint: With a saved posting selected, its analyzed data is used automatically and this field is ignored.
workspace.recommendAutoHint: Recommendations refresh when the job posting changes, using company, role, and JD. Low-similarity items are hidden.
workspace.recommendEmpty: No experiences scored high enough for this posting. Enrich your library or check the job details.
workspace.recommendedHint: Click to select — considered when generating the cover letter.
workspace.sectionTitlesDesc: Add the questions/titles required by the posting in order, and paragraphs will be generated in that order. Leave empty for the default structure (motivation → experience → aspiration). Each section targets about 1000–2000 characters.
workspace.step2Desc: Controls how strongly to rewrite wording and sentence structure. Facts, numbers, and timelines stay the same — 100% means full expression rewrite, not invention.
workspace.scoreNaturalnessDesc: How natural the writing reads, as if written by a person rather than sounding AI-generated.
workspace.scoreCompanyFitDesc: How well the cover letter matches the job posting's role, culture, and required skills.
workspace.scoreStyleRetentionDesc: How much of the applicant's original tone and phrasing was preserved after rewriting.
workspace.scoreAiTracePercentDesc: The share of sentences that read as AI-generated. Lower is better.
workspace.scoreStarApplicationDesc: How well experiences are described using the Situation-Task-Action-Result structure.
workspace.scoreExperienceUtilizationDesc: How specifically the experiences from your experience library are reflected in the cover letter.
workspace.resultEmpty: Set up the posting and section titles on the left, then click generate.
workspace.diagnosisDesc: Diagnoses naturalness and completeness sentence by sentence.
workspace.diagnosisEmpty: Generate a cover letter to see per-sentence diagnosis results.
workspace.sectionTitleCountMismatch: The number of section titles does not match the generated paragraphs. Check your titles or regenerate.
workspace.clearDraftDesc: Clears saved job input, AI results, and recommendations. This cannot be undone.
workspace.saveToDashboardSuccess: Saved to your cover letter list.
workspace.scoreFallbackNotice: AI evaluation failed — showing default values
workspace.reviewFallbackNotice: AI review failed — showing default feedback
workspace.interviewFallbackNotice: AI generation failed — showing default questions
workspace.keywordFallbackNotice: AI analysis failed — showing simple comparison

settings.title: Account settings
settings.myPageSubtitle: Manage career, education, skills, and cover letter sections.
settings.passwordSectionDesc: Change your password periodically for security.

portfolio.overviewSubtitle: Review at a glance on the dashboard.
portfolio.certificationsHint: Enter certification names as free text. Optionally match them against the national qualification catalog.
portfolio.coverLetterHint: Draft each section for the workspace.
portfolio.certTextHint: Plain text is enough — no fixed format required.
portfolio.certLookupNotConfigured: External certification catalog API is not configured. Your text will still be saved.

versionCompare.needTwo: Need at least two versions to compare.
